risks.risk: Panel wattage/model is unknown; price depends heavily on rated power (W) and panel type (mono/poly) and age/quality.
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the panel label/serial sticker showing brand, model, and rated wattage (W), plus a photo of the junction box.
risks.if_unproven: Price as generic used solar panels with unknown wattage (worst-case: lower output/older or unverified condition).

risks.risk: Quantity is uncertain (how many panels total in the package). Photo 0 shows only part of the array.
risks.proof: A wide shot showing the full array count, or a photo with all panels visible end-to-end.
risks.if_unproven: Price for the minimum clearly visible quantity in the photo (worst-case: fewer panels than expected).

risks.risk: Electrical condition is unverified (possible damage, reduced performance, or faulty cells).
risks.proof: Test proof: IV curve/test report or a simple multimeter/insulation test result, plus photos of any damage on corners/backs.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not guaranteed to be fully functional at rated output (worst-case: treat as lower performance).

risks.risk: Mounting/frame condition and completeness are unknown (rails, brackets, wiring, MC4 connectors).
risks.proof: Photos of the full mounting hardware and wiring/MC4 connectors included in the sale.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming missing/uncertain accessories (worst-case: buyer may need to replace connectors/brackets).

proof_requests: Close-up photo of one panel’s label/serial sticker (brand, model, rated wattage W, and type).
Wide photo showing the full array so the total number of panels is unambiguous.
Photo of the junction box and backsheet/corners for damage checks.
Any test/receipt/IV curve or performance proof (even a basic test report).
Photos of included accessories: MC4 connectors, cables, mounting rails/brackets, and whether an inverter/charge controller is included (if claimed).
response.reason: From photo 0, the item appears to be solar panels, but the key pricing drivers (panel model/wattage, total quantity, and condition/performance) are not readable or verifiable. Without those, a correct worst-case price cannot be set confidently.
